'''Story'''
---- Tower Defense Simulator contains a story, which mainly revolves around the [[T.D.S. Organization]] keeping the [[Overworld]] and other realms stable, while also securing any [[God Cube]] fragments. Currently, most of the story is contained within limited-time events and promotional videos.
